stemMd: Three machines are started 4 minutes apart. Each runs for 11 minutes. If the first starts at 10:00, when does the last finish?
explanationMd: The start times are 10:00,10:04 and 10:08. Add eleven minutes to the last start to get 10:19. Three starts create two four-minute gaps.

distractorRationale.e: This starts only two machines four minutes apart.
distractorRationale.a: This adds three starting gaps rather than two.
distractorRationale.b: This is the first machine’s finishing time.
distractorRationale.c: This assumes the runs are consecutive rather than overlapping.
